id: AT-SW-05 (settings writer: set and reset land in the case's temp HOME)
note: HOME-GUARD (0.1.2): `settings set --apply` and `settings reset --apply` write ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/settings.json; under this runner that is the case's temp $HOME/.claude/settings.json, with no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The real settings files (the real HOME's and the account's ~/.claude/settings.json, and the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR one the runner started with) get no helper backup beside them and are neither emptied nor removed across both writes (a change with no backup is another writer's of the live file: noted, not failed), and the runner's own temp HOME gets no .claude. The strict check: a child run of the runner started with HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at stand-ins that hold a settings.json runs the same set and reset (_sw01), which pass, and both stand-in files keep their sha256 with no backup beside them; a child run over a case whose given file changes and gets a helper backup beside it fails that case with both lines
